headline: Media and entertainment see strong revenue growth while gaming shows mixed results and publishing balances AI investment with modest earnings.
summary: Disney leads media with 7% revenue growth and expanding AI projects. Gaming is split, Caesars loses money despite stable digital spend, while Bally's posts strong top‑line growth. Publishing firms invest heavily in AI, but Scholastic misses revenue targets. Education players, especially Pearson, report accelerating revenue and expanding tech spend.

industries.summary: Disney posted a 7% revenue increase to $25.2 bn and is expanding AI partnerships. WBD is tightening IT spend while targeting synergies. Versant adds AI‑driven acquisitions and digital platform growth.

leaders.why: Highest revenue at $25,248 m and strong AI partnership with Adobe

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Disney and Versant are building generative AI models and expanding digital platforms.

themes.title: Cost management
themes.detail: WBD is tightening spend and pursuing $6 bn of synergies.

industries.it_note: IT spend ranges from expanding at Disney and Versant to tightening at WBD, indicating varied investment cycles.

industries.summary: Caesars reports a $2.94 bn revenue but a GAAP loss, while Bally's sees 22% YoY revenue growth. Light & Wonder and Brightstar maintain stable margins but face modest declines.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Caesars and Bally's invest in iGaming and streaming platforms, driving modest digital revenue growth.

themes.title: Cashless technology rollout
themes.detail: Light & Wonder launches RAPIDPLAY cashless slot systems across multiple venues.

industries.it_note: IT spend is stable at Caesars and Brightstar, unclear at Bally's and Light & Wonder, reflecting divergent strategic priorities.

industries.summary: Pearson reports accelerated revenue and expanding AI initiatives. NYU secures large AI and quantum research investments. SLU adds AI focus through a partnership while outsourcing custodial services.

leaders.why: Only disclosed revenue figure at $1,779 m and strong growth

laggards.why: Smallest disclosed revenue among education players

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Pearson and NYU invest heavily in AI for learning and research, signaling sector‑wide digital transformation.

industries.it_note: Education institutions are increasing technology spend, especially in AI research and platform development.
